skill.summary: Coordinate agents toward a unified objective; assign roles, sequence work, prevent conflicts, and define success criteria.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the strategic-orchestration skill for coordinating multiple agents toward a shared objective.
- Assigns clear roles to agents (Morpheus, RedHat, Trinity, Smith) and sequences their work.
- Prevents conflicts through ownership definition, success criteria, and interface mapping.
- Outputs a structured orchestration plan, detailing execution steps, agent roles, dependencies, handoff messages, and success criteria.
- Enforces safety by requiring explicit approval for irreversible actions and restricting delegation boundaries.
